objective: Determine whether the screen-selected projected-slot plus recurrent-RWKV hybrid remains trainable and causally RWKV-dependent after exactly one synchronized BF16 update on locked open native rows.

training.distribution: one locked source row per rank with summed gradients and identical optimizer state

post_update_causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected keys, values, occupancy, and surprise with recurrent readout bypassed.
post_update_causal_conditions.hybrid_correct: Correct-row projected bundle plus the complete correct-row recurrent bundle.
post_update_causal_conditions.hybrid_zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while every recurrent tensor is zeroed.
post_update_causal_conditions.hybrid_matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while the complete recurrent bundle comes from the locked different-gold, write-length-matched donor.
post_update_causal_conditions.prohibited_confound: Projected state, updated adapter weights, base weights, query tokens, and decoding positions may not change between causal conditions.

stopping_rule.pass: Archive, commit, and push the signed result, then separately preregister the matched open native benchmark. Do not open a protected split.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive, commit, and push the signed failure. The native benchmark remains blocked; redesign the hybrid interface before another calibration.
stopping_rule.always: This calibration performs exactly one optimizer update and does not run the native benchmark.

claim_policy.calibration_pass: May claim only that the selected hybrid is BF16-trainable and remains causally dependent on recurrent RWKV state after one locked native update.
claim_policy.calibration_failure: Must report the failed gate and may not start matched native benchmark training.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without a later preregistered matched open native evaluation against projected-only and base-model controls.
